column1: Note: Includes the largest jails in 45 states and the District of Columbia and jail jurisdictions with an average daily population of 1,000 or more inmates. Excludes data for five states with combined prison-and-jail systems: Connecticut, Delaware, Hawaii, Rhode Island, and Vermont. Includes large jail data for Alaska though it also operates a combined prison-and-jail system. See Terms and definitions for information on types of victimization.
a/Allegations of abusive sexual contact could not be counted separately from allegations of nonconsensual sexual acts.
b/Allegations of staff sexual harassment could not be counted separately from allegations of staff sexual misconduct.
c/Counts of nonconsensual sexual acts were based on completed acts only.
d/Allegations of staff sexual harassment were not recorded.
e/Counts of staff sexual misconduct were based on substantiated incidents only.
